dedupe_keys.name: gsni geoindex minerals layers active quarries mineral occurrences mineral licensing northern ireland

description: The GSNI GeoIndex is the Geological Survey of Northern Ireland's map index, distributed by BGS, and three of its layers cover minerals. Active quarries shows quarries and pits producing hard rock and aggregate products, based on GSNI surveys whose latest compilation dates from 1999 to 2000. Mineral occurrences lists occurrences recorded in GSNI publications and is updated as exploration data are released from confidentiality under the Mineral Development Act (NI) 1969. Mineral licensing shows the outlines of current mining licences, mineral prospecting licences (January 2010 layer) and historic licence areas. Coverage is Northern Ireland. Access: the layers are viewed free in the online GeoIndex; data.gov.uk lists copyright as vested in NERC with reuse requiring permission, and no download format is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the quarry layer is more than 25 years old and the licence layers here are older than the Department for the Economy's own open licence data. For simulation it locates aggregate sources and exploration areas in Northern Ireland for supply and land-use studies. Related catalogue records include the Northern Ireland mineral prospecting licences and mining leases and BGS BritPits.
